context.transcript:
Before I end this meeting, I want to discuss the details of our upcoming trip to our factory in Tokyo.
Our flight arrives on Monday and we'll take the train from the airport to our hotel.
Now, you'll need to exchange your dollars for local currency.
The airport does offer currency exchange.
But they charge a pretty expensive fee However, there's a bank near the hotel Anyway, on Tuesday, the on-site manager will be giving us a tour of the facility We'll be at the factory for most of the day
context.transcript_translation:
在我结束这次会议之前，我想讨论一下我们即将前往东京工厂的行程细节。
我们的航班周一到达，然后我们会从机场乘坐火车到酒店。
现在，你需要把你的美元兑换成当地货币。
机场确实提供货币兑换服务。
但他们收取的费用相当昂贵。不过，酒店附近有一家银行。总之，周二，现场经理会带我们参观设施。我们大部分时间都会在工厂度过。
